mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which positively impacts consumer confidence and spending, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is low but S&P 500 returns are negative, or if Rank IC < 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) crosses above 2.5%, it indicates monetary tightening, which can lead to decreased corporate borrowing and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) coupled with increasing federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) may signal inflationary pressures and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise but S&P 500 returns are positive, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) during a late-cycle expansion indicates strong demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but S&P 500 returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO grows but S&P 500 returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases but S&P 500 returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) accompanied by rising unemployment (UNRATE) may indicate stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 grows and UNRATE rises but S&P 500 returns are positive, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real state and local government purchases (RSAFS) during an early-cycle recovery indicates increased government spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but S&P 500 returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03.
